precepts.text: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me. Babylon says the exact same words God says of himself: I am, and none else beside me. A nation putting itself in the seat of God is blasphemy. And believing that your people can never rule themselves, that the world cannot run without your oppressor, is the same blasphemy: saying what God made cannot do what God promised.
precepts.point: Thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. That is the intelligence agencies destabilizing countries and neutralizing leaders in the dark. Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels: the think tanks. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee. Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame.

note.label: Blasphemers & Traitors: Judge Not Before the Time

precepts.why:
Babylon, “given to pleasures”, that “dwellest carelessly”, says in her heart, “I am, and none else beside me.” Where does she get that from? Isaiah 46 shows it: “Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me.”

That is what God says of himself, and Babylon says the exact same thing. America puts herself in the seat of God. You are a man, but if you want I will make you a woman; I can fix that, I made that happen. America is the land of entitlement and privilege. She does what she wants to others and to her own people: passes laws secretly, changes laws, raises prices and brings them down, puts people in office who do not belong there. She dwells carelessly, and she makes her citizens care less, read less, think less and do less.

That is blasphemy from Babylon’s mouth and actions. And our people share in it, because they cannot see a world without the white man ruling the planet. They say he has to be saved, because they cannot see Negroes ever ruling the earth; we can’t rule over ourselves without him. That is blasphemy, an insult to God: saying what God made cannot rule over its own people. You are in hell trying to give your oppressor a heaven.

But God alone is God, and the one who says “I am” in his place is brought down: “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne.” The loss of children and widowhood come upon her “in a moment in one day”, “in their perfection”, every missile hitting its target as God intends, and her astrologers and prognosticators “shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them.”

precepts.text: Declaring the end from the beginning: there was a council with the Father before time, his counsel shall stand and cannot be thrown off track, and this destruction is his pleasure even if it is not yet yours.
precepts.point: See that ye be not troubled, for all these things must come to pass: those troubled and fearful are the ones with secret sin on the back end. Deacon Obadiah does not see America lasting fifteen to twenty more years; now is not the time to play with your salvation.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
“See that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass”. Why must they come to pass? Because it was already ordained to happen this way. That is why this Bible is a great mystery given to the sons of the living God.

“Declaring the end from the beginning”. God declared the end from the creation of the earth. There was already a council with us and our heavenly Father, and all of us agreed to take our roles as the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. “And from ancient times”: there is no time with God; he is beyond time. God declared the end of this white man's captivity from the beginning. He declared our rulership from the beginning. He gave us the playbook before time was even created.

“The things that are not yet done”. We are walking and living through the timeline of prophecy. Things declared from ancient times are unfolding right before our eyes, and still many read it and do not believe it.

“Saying, My counsel shall stand”. God's counsel and his will shall be done. You cannot move it around, thwart it, or throw it off track. Whether you believe it or not, prophecy will be fulfilled; the word of the Lord will not go out void.

“And I will do all my pleasure”. This destruction was declared before time existed, and it is pleasure in the sight of the Lord. But many of our people do not see it as pleasure; they are fearful of the Lord's pleasure, fearful of freedom, while they love sin. Every war and rumour of war since 1917 has been a birthing pain. The ones who are troubled are the ones with secret sin on the back end. Now is not the time to play with your salvation.

precepts.text: When I heard, my belly trembled, my lips quivered, rottenness entered into my bones, that I might rest in the day of trouble. Habakkuk saw the missiles hit and ten thousand fall at his side, and the anxiety sat in his chest; he said I do not want to be alive to see this.
precepts.point: Iran is destroying the world economy and bringing the dollar to nothing by cutting the oil that must be sold in dollars. Gas is already five dollars a gallon two weeks in. In my opinion, America will let it happen so it can introduce digital currency, and with it the digital ID that controls what you buy, eat, and wear. Every truck from the port to the warehouse to your store runs on gas, so food goes up, and the small businesses are already shutting down; the Bishop told you to buy food when it was cheap and you said Judah does not know what he is talking about.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

precepts.why:
God is “declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done.” Only the God of Israel can do that, and he shows the end to the prophets. Look at the videos of the missiles coming down at night: don't they look like stars falling from heaven? The prophets had never seen a missile, an Iron Dome, a supersonic missile or a nuclear weapon. They described what they saw to the best of their ability, and it is our job to put it together. Put yourself in the prophet's shoes, because you are the prophets; you just don't remember.

Habakkuk describes how it hurts when these missiles hit, because when they hit they bring destruction. You don't want to be around when a missile hits the ground; you don't even want to be ten feet away.

“When I heard, my belly trembled.” That kind of fear is an anxiety sitting inside you, in your chest. He cannot believe what he is watching, but the Lord had to show it to him. “My lips quivered at the voice”: he was shaking, he couldn't even talk straight. “Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself.” He could not believe the damage this thing was doing, the number of people it killed when it hit.

“That I might rest in the day of trouble.” He is saying, I don't want to be alive to see this. It is so bad I don't want to be around to see it. That is what Psalms 91 means by a thousand falling at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand: he saw the bomb drop and ten thousand people die right there.

That is the end God declared from the beginning, and “My counsel shall stand.” The media say Hamas is finished, Hezbollah has no weapons, Iran is weak; yet Hezbollah fired a hundred missiles into Israel the other day, and Israel cannot destroy Hamas under its nose while Iran is seven times bigger than Israel. We are going with the Bible. If you want the kingdom of heaven, you must accept what comes with it: war, tribulation and death.

precepts.text: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure. This is our power: the Most High planned every war, including the third world war, from the time of Adam. He is behind the Israelis in the US government and behind Iran's twenty years of tunnels and munitions. Chattel slavery, Jim Crow, and civil rights were his pleasure too; we had to learn the lesson.
precepts.point: They send drones that cost fifteen to twenty thousand dollars and the other side fires interceptors that cost a million or more to knock them down. You see how they will not be able to keep up, and how God put all this in these leaders.

note.label: Wars Are Here: Seek Good Not Evil

precepts.why:
Amos says “the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land”. When Iran is being touched right now, and Israel, the Lord is involved in all of it; by his counsel the land gets touched. Isaiah shows that counsel: “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done”.

This is the power we have: understanding that the Most High God from the very beginning planned every war, including the third world war to come. Ancient times means way back when Adam and Eve walked. From then he declared it. As his sons and daughters, the Israelites, we have to know our Father has this covered and his Son is coming back. Right now we have to rehearse the righteous acts and get right.

That is how we can make the bold statement that God is behind the Israelis doing what they do in the US government, and behind the Iranians spending twenty years building huge, elaborate tunnel systems and storing munitions and advanced rocketry. All of it was set up from ancient times. They send drones that cost fifteen to twenty thousand dollars, and the other side fires interceptor missiles that cost a million or more to take them out. You see how they will not be able to keep up. God put all that in these leaders.

“My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”. It was his pleasure when we went into chattel slavery, through Jim Crow and through civil rights. We had to learn the lesson.

Jeremiah shows the same counsel: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon”. “Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: Israel, the least of Esau's flock, draws the United States out into the Middle East, and “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved”. Amos lived way before anything could melt the land. Today thermonuclear ICBMs can, and it is all by his counsel.

precepts.text: Remember this, and shew yourselves men; bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors. God gave you a mind to envision greatness and see things before your hands build them, and to set up a congregation with no evil among the brothers and sisters. I am God, and there is none like me, declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done: he had the end figured out before let there be light, down to the fourth bird from the hen that flies over Wyoming on a given day because it connects to something you know nothing about. Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country; I have purposed it, I will also do it. Not a sparrow falls without your Father, and you try to move God while you will not keep the commandments.
precepts.point: The vision is yet for an appointed time; at the end it shall speak, and not lie; though it tarry, wait for it, because it will surely come. Habakkuk, Ezra, the disciples, everyone asked when; do not worry, it is coming, so be ready. Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him, Esau; but the just shall live by his faith, by the words of the book of our fathers.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
Habakkuk stood on his tower demanding answers: how long are we going to be in this captivity? The Lord answered, “the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come”. Now that we know what time we are in, Isaiah says, “Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.”

Be men and use your mind. God gave the sons of God a mind to envision greatness, to see things in the mind before the hands build them. He gave you that vantage point so you can set up a congregation and make sure evil does not come among the brothers and sisters. O ye transgressors: change.

“I am God, and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done”. God declared the end before he said, Let there be light. Everything falls in the path he wants it to fall. He knew from ancient times that the fourth bird from the mother hen would fly over Wyoming on March 7th, 2028. You say that bird is insignificant; he says, I need that bird to do that because it is connected to something else you don't know about. That is his vantage point.

“Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country”. While he causes that bird to come from the east, he calls another man to execute his judgment. “I have purposed it, I will also do it.” A sparrow shall not fall to the ground unless the Most High causes it. Everything is under his auspices; he knows why he holds the armies back so the earth is not destroyed. You and I are not on that level, and we try to move God while we will not keep the commandments. The only thing we need to do is obey what he said.

That is why the vision will not lie. We cannot reason out why he calls that insignificant raven, but in God's overall plan it is necessary, and the end he declared from the beginning will surely come.

precepts.point: Remember the former things of old, for I am God, declaring the end from the beginning; my counsel shall stand.

note.label: Destroyed by Familiar Hands

precepts.why:
“Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors. Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else.” Only God is “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” Where do you find God’s counsel? The Bible. Whatever the scripture says, the prophecy is going to happen. Forget the dumb pastors and dumb Christians who do not know anything.

Amos shows who is behind what is happening: “Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The trumpet is the Bible. And yes, there is evil in America, and the Lord has done it.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” We are the prophets. Our job, brothers, is to prepare our people for what is coming. Our job is not to pick up guns and knives thinking you can do something to the white man; this man will wipe you out just like that. Our job is to bring the people back to Messiah and prepare their minds for the second coming of Jesus Christ, the black Messiah, revealing the Bible plainly so they may repent. Wait on the Lord.

“come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.” We are Zion, and our job is to declare in Zion the work of the Lord: what is coming, and how to fix your spirit and build yourself up. To our brothers and sisters in Venezuela: repent. You cannot stop the white man; let him do what he was supposed to do. The evil in the city is the Lord’s counsel standing, and it is revealed to his prophets.

precepts.point: Sing with gladness for Jacob and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel. Salvation in the Bible is named over a people, and the churches have been deceiving people for centuries on it.

precepts.point: From the questions: the Lord dealt with Moses on a level where Moses could speak to him so, but the outcome stood on what was declared from the beginning; had it been his pleasure to destroy, nothing Moses said could have stayed it.

note.label: Exodus 32: The Golden Calf at Horeb

precepts.why:
“Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”.

“And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.” The Most High does not repent as a man; he has no one to answer to. He simply turned from the anger of that moment. He was never going to break his covenant, for consuming the people would have destroyed all the seed of Jacob except Moses, and he had sworn by his own self to Abraham, Isaac and Israel to multiply their seed as the stars of heaven. Moses was there to remind him of his own word.

The Lord dealt with Moses on a level where Moses could speak to him so, but the outcome stood on what was declared from the beginning. Had it been his pleasure to destroy, nothing Moses said could have stayed it: my counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.

precepts.text: Declaring the end from the beginning: my counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure; whoever the Most High wants to win a war is going to win it.
precepts.point: The Most High strengthens nations and weakens nations, and moves peoples in and out of lands to fulfil his word. In this last battle Israel cannot lose so long as we keep the commandments, have faith in Christ, and endure to the end; but if we stay in sin, we die with the heathen.

note.label: Judges 11: Jephthah and the Search of the Fathers

precepts.why:
“the Lord the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.” The Lord is in the midst of every battle; nothing goes down without the Most High letting it go down. “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”. Whoever the Most High wants to win a war is going to win it. World War One, the Lord was in the midst; World War Two, the Lord was in the midst; whoever he has destined to win is going to win.

That is how the Lord dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and why the king of Ammon “hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah”: the Lord had hardened their hearts not to listen, the same as he did with Sihon. The Most High strengthens nations and weakens nations, and moves peoples in and out of lands to fulfil his word. His counsel shall stand.

precepts.text: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done; that is what prophecy is, and we have a sure word of it.
precepts.point: The testimony of the Lord is sure; the testimonies and prophecies in this Bible are sure.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
“Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”. That is what prophecy is: the Most High declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things not yet done.

His counsel shall stand, and we have a sure word of it. That is the testimony of the Lord that is sure, making wise the simple.

precepts.text: He will place salvation in Zion for Israel His glory; Israel is God's glory.
precepts.point: Israel is God's glory, so declaring His glory among the heathen means the so-called blacks, native Indians, and Hispanics are coming back to their glory, coming back to God's law, statutes, and commandments. God is putting us back in order among the heathen; we are coming back to our traditions and our heritage and leaving the heritage of the heathen.

note.label: Psalm 96: Declare His Glory Among the Heathen

precepts.why:
“I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.” Israel is God's glory; he says it plainly.

So to declare his glory among the heathen is to declare Israel among the heathen. God is putting us back in order right in the midst of the nations: the so-called blacks, native Indians and Hispanics are coming back to their glory, back to his law, his statutes and his commandments, and his salvation is placed in Zion for us.

precepts.text: The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants who keep his laws.
precepts.point: The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants, the ones keeping his laws; the nations and the enemies of the Most High shall see those Israelites rising.

note.label: Isaiah 66: The Most High's Throne, Zion's Travail, and Judgment by Fire

precepts.why:
“I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.” What is his glory? “I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.”

The glory of the Most High is Israel, his servants, the ones keeping his laws. He knows their works and their thoughts, and when he gathers all nations and tongues, the nations and the enemies of the Most High shall see those Israelites rising, salvation placed in Zion for Israel his glory.
